context7.description: Live documentation lookup for libraries/frameworks - no API key required

firecrawl.description: Self-hosted Firecrawl (see ../firecrawl/), verified working via a live scrape smoke test. USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION=false in this setup so no FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is needed; add one back if you turn auth on. To use Firecrawl Cloud instead, drop FIRECRAWL_API_URL and set a real FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

obsidian.description: Read/search/write your Obsidian vault. Requires the 'Local REST API' community plugin (coddingtonbear/obsidian-local-rest-api) enabled in Obsidian, with Obsidian running. Known issue: Python MCP SDK 2.0+ breaks this server's handler registration - it's pinned <2.0.0 upstream; if you see BrokenPipeError mid-session, check for an update.

browser-use.description: Agentic browsing - give it a task, it decides the steps. Complements lightpanda-playwright below (agent layer vs. browser engine, not a substitute).

lightpanda-playwright.description: Playwright MCP driven by a local Lightpanda browser instead of Chrome, for fast/cheap deterministic scraping. Start Lightpanda first: `lightpanda serve --port 9222`. Install: curl -fsSL https://pkg.lightpanda.io/install.sh | bash

codegraph.description: Codebase knowledge graph - search/context/callers/callees/impact/explore/node/files/status. Already installed locally (v1.5.0); run `codegraph init` in a project once to build its index. Generated via `codegraph install --print-config claude`.

_comments.usage: Copy the servers you need into ~/.claude.json's mcpServers section, or register the same command/args/env/url through the Bifrost UI (see ../bifrost/SETUP.md).
_comments.env_vars: Replace YOUR_*_HERE placeholders with real values. Never commit real secrets to this repo.
_comments.graphify: Evaluated and intentionally omitted - overlaps Codegraph almost entirely and Codegraph was already installed. See ../docs/DECISIONS.md.
